headline: Severe Clashes Shake Weathered Expanse As Linn Of Mercy Reignites
war_summary: Frontline clashes remain centered on Weathered Expanse, where six strategic base exchanges were recorded over the past two hours amid over four thousand combined casualties, with Frostmarch continuing as the primary pivot of combat. Linn of Mercy has likewise reignited after a brief lull, logging two fresh base transitions at Lathair as casualty rates surged sharply over the latest hour. In contrast, the rapid base trades recently noted in Mooring County, Godcrofts, and Fisherman's Row have paused during the last two hours, though Mooring County continues to sustain punishing attrition with over seventeen hundred casualties in that interval. Massive attritional battles persist across Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle, each absorbing thousands of casualties under accelerating deployment rates without yielding immediate base flips. Further west, Nevish Line exhibits rising engagement rates, while Stlican Shelf and Farranac Coast have largely settled into steady positional fighting following earlier rounds of structural turnover.
